app-templates.message:
fix(explainer): the tutor prompt's links start at the root of the language tree on every page

## Intent

The tutor section moved to every page, but its prompt still took the page's own folder as the base. On a page it linked llms.txt below that page, an address that does not exist.

## Key changes

- The tutor section gives the root of the language tree, relative to its page, and the prompt's links start there.
- An e2e check and a build test make sure llms.txt and the tutor files are linked at the root.

## Dependencies and side effects

- The tooling pins this version in the same intent.
